---
title: "Project receives additional support from Queens College, CUNY"
date: 2026-11-02
description: "A Queens College Research Enhancement Grant will fund an undergraduate research assistant for Spring 2027."
---

*The Productive Role of Error in AI-Driven Modeling*, funded by the Alfred P.
Sloan Foundation, has received additional support through a Queens College
Research Enhancement Grant.

The award will fund an undergraduate research assistant to work with project
PI [Ryan O'Loughlin](../people.qmd#ryan-oloughlin) during Spring 2027. The
research assistant will help build the project's conceptual groundwork in its
first year: synthesizing the literature in philosophy of science and
philosophy of AI on error, explainability and scientific credibility, and
helping prepare for the project's [workshop](../workshop.qmd) at Queens
College.

The award also strengthens the project's commitment to undergraduate research
training at Queens College. Funded research positions are rare in philosophy,
and this one is structured as a research apprenticeship built around regular
working sessions with the PI.

A [description of the research assistant position](../research-assistant.qmd)
is available.
